Dṛḍhaprahārikathā
Jain. Jainagranthāvalī p. 253. Pattan I. p. 61 (Pkt.).

Dṛḍhabala
or Kāpilabali. medical writer; son of Kapilabali; resident of Pañcanadapura in Kashmir. Prob. latter part of 3rd Cent. an. early 4th Cent.; quoted in Aṣṭāṅgasaṅgraha of Vāgbhaṭa.
--redacted Carakasam3hitā.
Q. by several later medical writers.
See G. Mukhopadhyaya, HIMed. III. p.. 622ff.; also Atridev Vidyalankar, Āyurved kā Bṛhat Itihās p.. 154ff.
